Stop chasing. Let price come BACK. ⏳

The big move already happened? Good. Mark the order block it left behind and wait. The best entries come on the return, with a tight stop and a clear target.

1️⃣ Find the impulse
2️⃣ Mark the order block
3️⃣ Enter on the return
